# Vendored media-control

The CLI script is from `ungive/media-control` revision
`3cfd5dcf78e7a619f7a42a3e2f29b06eb41027ea`.
Its MediaRemoteAdapter submodule is from `ungive/mediaremote-adapter` revision
`e3ff5021eb0875858bd05f48d2e9ba2e962d1cf6`.

Scripts, Objective-C sources, headers, and original copyright notices are
retained without source changes. TuneFlick builds the adapter and its test
client with `Scripts/build-media-control.sh` for both macOS architectures.
The repository does not need a submodule checkout or prebuilt download.

Both components use BSD-3-Clause. See their local LICENSE files and
`THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md` at the repository root.
